newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Colombo exchange halts trading in Vanik, Forbes.
newsitem.headline: Colombo exchange halts trading in Vanik, Forbes.

text.p: The Colombo Stock Exchange (CSE) said on Thursday it had imposed a one-day trading ban on shares of Vanik Incorporation Ltd and Forbes Ceylon Ltd to disseminate news about a proposed merger.
"A trading halt will be imposed on Vanik and Forbes on Thursday, July 31, in order to disseminate the information," the CSE said in a statement.
Vanik said in a letter to the CSE it was negotiating with Global Equity Corporation to buy the Canadian firm's 50 percent stake in Forbes Ceylon on a general offer.

A statement from Asia Capital Ltd, which controls 11 percent of Forbes Ceylon's issued capital of 240 million 10-rupee shares, said Vanik had agreed not to pursue the acquisition without making a similar offer to minority shareholders of Forbes.
The Securities & Exchange Commission code governing takeovers and mergers says anyone buying control of a company has to make a similar offer to minority sharehodlers.
